kind: sanitized historical aggregate, not a new evaluation

training.selection: Complete validation of six saved checkpoints, before behavioral review

behavioral_screen.review: developer semantic review of all 200 outputs, not independent qualified expert validation

limits: Foundation, template and quantization differ: not a weight-only causal comparison.

provenance_policy: Personal plans and real client records excluded from shared weights; separately authored synthetic examples and reviewed public references supported the experiment.
